name: Akamai Technologies

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org (Akamai-2025.svg); the en.wikipedia infobox has no logo

description: Akamai runs a large distributed network (more than 4,300 edge locations plus core and distributed compute sites) and sells security, content delivery and cloud computing on it. Security (web application firewall, bot management, DDoS, zero-trust and microsegmentation) is 53% of revenue and growing 10%; delivery is 30% and shrinking 5% a year; cloud computing (the former Linode, now Akamai Connected Cloud) is 17% and growing 12%. It reports one segment and no customer is 10% of revenue. Operating margin is 13.5% on a GAAP basis (29.8% non-GAAP).

employees.note: "Over 11,000" employees in more than 30 countries; about 65% outside the U.S.

businessLines.name: Security
businessLines.how: Customers contract for ongoing protection (application and API security, DDoS, bot management, zero-trust and microsegmentation); the 10-K treats these as stand-ready services recognised over the contract term.

businessLines.name: Delivery
businessLines.how: Fees for content and application delivery over Akamai's edge network, a stand-ready service recognised over the contract term; mature and price-pressured.

businessLines.name: Cloud computing
businessLines.how: Fees for compute, storage and cloud infrastructure services (Akamai Connected Cloud, built on the Linode acquisition) recognised over the service period.

brands.name: Linode (Akamai Connected Cloud)
brands.note: Basis of the cloud computing line; revenue shown as the Cloud computing line ($708.1M).

brands.name: Guardicore, Noname, Fermyon
brands.note: Acquired businesses named in the 10-K; revenue not broken out.

whatsNext.text: The $2.0 billion repurchase program expires at the end of June 2027.
